content.content:
# SB 392 - Personal Income Tax Reduction

**Applicability Language:**
"The provisions of this section shall be applicable in determining the rates of tax imposed by this article and shall apply for all taxable years beginning on and after January 1, 2026" (§11-21-4j(e)).

**Tax Rate Table (Single/Head of Household/Married Filing Jointly):**

| Income Level | Tax Rate |
|---|---|
| Not over $10,000 | 2.11% |
| $10,000–$25,000 | $211 + 2.81% over $10,000 |
| $25,000–$40,000 | $632.50 + 3.16% over $25,000 |
| $40,000–$60,000 | $1,106.50 + 4.22% over $40,000 |
| Over $60,000 | "$1,950.50 plus 4.58% of excess over $60,000" |

**Passage & Effective Dates:**
- Passed: March 14, 2026
- Effective: June 12, 2026 (90 days from passage)
- Tax rates apply: January 1, 2026 forward
